scope: E54: same-Xcode cache, launch, denied-API and no-log controls; no production runtime change

target_denials.limits: Only exact synthetic xcodebuild PID. Aggregated/duplicate log counts are not syscall timing; sample exited successfully but produced no call stacks. No IPC grant experiment.

method.ordering: Rotating/reversed case and mode order; serial unsanitized; direct API calls separately after correctness jobs completed
method.baseline: Current E53 explicit off with its usual clean environment; cold_env separately creates/deletes only its own HOME/TMPDIR; on always has a fresh private temporary directory
method.quiet_candidate: Exact E53 runtime source with only (deny default) changed to (deny default (with no-log)); never shipped
method.source_provenance: Main sources archived before E55 environment-binding edits; direct IPC probe has separate source/binary hashes
method.timing_boundary: API wall includes prepare/spawn/command/cleanup; phase wall runs inside the unchanged sandbox; wait4 CPU counters may exclude helper work and are not a complete xcodebuild CPU account
method.privacy: Synthetic source only. Exact target PID log filtering; no unrelated application logs/args or raw logs included in public evidence

limits: No full call stacks were obtained: sample exited zero but call graph was empty. Cannot allocate the seconds among specific Xcode IPC retry/framework functions.
Mach denial microprobes use the same policy, not the full xcodebuild workload. Aggregated/duplicate OS logs are not exact syscall counts or timing.
No grant of rejected Mach services, passwd/group contents, user cache, network or broader system paths was tested or shipped.

Initial direct Clang without SDK failed; direct xcodebuild -find produced plugin errors and exceeded retained output, so its phase marker was unavailable. Development probes are not pooled into formal timing.
No model inference or historical streaming/KV performance rerun.
